_note: Tome's first-week list (data/goals.json, Goals): when a goal is done the farmer ticks its line and reads the thank-you note a villager wrote under it (the reward is already in hand). Parts start at the goal ids plant, hello, forage, fish, ship and earn; each ends with next: end. Our own lines.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: Nine plots sown. That's the first line on Tome's list ticked off. There's a note under it.

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: Well begun, dear! A little something for more seeds. Water them every morning, mind. - Tome

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: Three new faces said hello. Next on Tome's list... someone else wrote this note.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Tome told me you'd be hungry. Three rice balls from the store, on the house! - Sayo

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: Four wild plants, free for the picking! Tome's note says:

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: The hills feed anyone who looks. These cucumber seeds climb a stake and keep giving all spring. - Tome

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: My first fish! There's a scrawl on Tome's list in a child's hand.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Hachiro says the first fish is the hardest. Here's my pocket money, I don't need it! - Kota

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: Five crops in the bin. A neat note under that line, signed with a seal.

lines.speaker: tsuru
lines.text: The village welcomes its new farmer's first harvest. Seed potatoes from the meeting hall's store. - Tsuru

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: A thousand gold from the cart! That's the last line on Tome's list. And... is something peeping?

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: One of my hens hatched more chicks than I can keep. She's in your coop now. Feed her and she'll lay for you.

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: That's my whole list done. From here on the farm is yours to plan. I'm proud of you, dear. - Tome
